what_this_is: The 14 messages of the fourth fresh set, written by a different AI family (OpenAI's model through its own command-line tool) from each slot's kind and sample/WRITING-RULES.md only, after prompt v7. The only edit: a dash replaced by a comma (J-6004, J-6012), for this project's no-dash rule.
